## Added

- `downsample`: a smaller copy of a PDF, by resampling the raster images drawn
  above a resolution (`--dpi`, default 200; `--threshold-dpi`, default 10 %
  above; `--quality` for JPEGs, default 85). Only image streams are replaced —
  content streams, fonts and `ToUnicode` maps are byte-identical, so text
  extraction is unchanged, which Ghostscript's `pdfwrite` does not guarantee.
  Resolution is measured at the size an image is drawn; JPEGs (grey, RGB,
  Adobe CMYK/YCCK) stay JPEGs and lossless images stay lossless. Images it
  cannot resample without a colour conversion are counted by reason in
  `unchanged`. The file written is never larger than the input. The output is
  the new `downsample` section of `docs/json-api.md`.
- `dossier`: `groups[].access[]` on ownership and administrative groups — the
  number and passcode («գաղտնաբառ») an ownership certificate or a reference
  letter prints in its header, which together are what the register asks for
  before it will show its own copy. The toolkit reads the pair and stops: no
  links are built and nothing is retrieved. A new `certificate_access` check
  reports whether every certificate page prints them: a page without is an
  `unreadable` witness, a dossier with no certificate page at all is one
  `unreadable` check — the absence is the finding. The passcode is also struck
  from `pages[].extraction.text`, the page title and the notes, so the secret
  lives in that one structured field instead of scattered through the text.
  Schema 0.4.0 (additive); the reviewed annotations regenerated.

## Changed

- The certificate test in `pdf-dossier` runs on synthetic values; the corpus
  excerpt it carried is gone from the source.
